name: Drum performance
description: A 48-second standing drum performance for the Drums tab: ready pose, count-in, rock groove, ride groove, tribal toms, open hi-hats, fills and a big ending with sticks in the air. 100 bpm. Loops.
axes: x = performer's right, y = up from the floor, z = behind the performer (the performer faces -z, towards Phone A)
